text:
maya: Quick follow-up from last night's incident — p99 spike on /v1/generate. Need owners + timelines for remediation and a decision on SLO tweak. Keeping this thread short.
ben: TL;DR — bursty client traffic + KV cache misses + batching jitter. p99 hit ~1.2s for small requests. Error budget spiked but not exhausted. We scaled and fell back fine.
priya: Agreed. Two tracks: 1) short-lived SLO adjustment to prevent noisy alerts, 2) infra/runtime fixes. I can own the SLO change and dashboard tile. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
julian: I'll own runtime work. Root cause looks like batching jitter when quantized paths hit cold caches. Can ship a config mitigation today, full patch in ~2 weeks.
zoe: Product note — we can't blanket-relax SLAs for enterprise customers. Can we scope any SLO change to hosted/free traffic only?
maya: Good point. Plan: scope SLO tweak to non-dedicated traffic. Proposal: for route /v1/generate (tenant_type != "dedicated") set p99 target to 800ms (was 500ms) for 14 days and monitor. Dedicated customers keep existing SLA. @priya please create a dashboard showing p99 + error_budget burn by tenant_type.
priya: On it. Dashboard panels: p50/p95/p99, error_budget_remaining per tenant, and burn_rate (1h). Grafana query I'll start from:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, tenant_type))
```
I'll add annotations for deploys/incidents and a link to the postmortem.
ben: I'll add a temporary alert rule: error_budget_burn_rate > 3 for 1h per tenant_type => page. Will update runbook with mitigation steps (scale-up, fallback to small-model variant).
julian: Quick mitigation to ship today: cap continuous-batch window to 16ms and add jitter smoothing. Default flag off, can canary roll now. Full deterministic fix (KV cache prewarm + quant path refactor) is the longer work.
maya: Assigning action items in-thread so we can sync to the postmortem ticket:
- priya: dashboard + SLO config change (owner: priya, due: tomorrow EOD)
- julian: config mitigation PR (owner: julian, due: today EOD) + full runtime patch (owner: julian, due: 2026-04-10)
- ben: alert + runbook update (owner: ben, due: today)
- zoe: customer comms & legal review for enterprise messaging (owner: zoe, due: tomorrow)
I will track these in the postmortem ticket. Reply if any conflicts.
zoe: No conflicts, I'll draft comms and ping legal.
julian: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 — config flag + canary rollout plan (5% -> 20% -> 100%).
priya: Dashboard created: https://grafana/redwood/d/p_generate_slo. SLO config updated in infra repo (infra/slo-configs/hosted.json). PR #1234 open referencing postmortem link.
oncall-bot: JIRA created: INFR-9876 'Postmortem follow-up: /v1/generate p99 mitigation & SLO update' assigned to maya. https://jira/redwood/browse/INFR-9876
maya: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene in 48h for a quick sync. If error budget burn > 1.5x before then, escalate immediately.
